shortDescription: Hackers say they stole a trove of Federal Bureau of Investigation data that includes records showing the home addresses of employees involved in cases on foreign spies, drug cartels and covert surveillance operations, according to Bloomberg.The material also contains job titles for those employees.

title: FBI Data Leak Exposes Agents’ Home Addresses
